ad_text: I India Post Savings Info Sponsored Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS) — a Government of India savings scheme for citizens aged 60 and above. Interest 8.2% per annum for the July–September 2026 quarter, paid every quarter. Deposit from ₹1,000 up to ₹30 lakh. Tax deduction available under Section 80C. Open your account at any post office or authorised bank branch. Details: www.indiapost.gov.in Learn more

data.headline: This looks like a genuine scheme. Invest only through official channels.
data.headline_hi: यह असली योजना लगती है। केवल आधिकारिक रास्ते से निवेश करें।
reasons: Promotes the genuine Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS) with the exact official interest rate of 8.2% p.a. for the July-September 2026 quarter.
Directs users to open the account at official channels (any post office or authorised bank branch) and provides the official domain www.indiapost.gov.in.
indiapost.gov.in is an official website of India Post
what_to_do: Invest only through the official channel: the post office, your bank branch, or the company's own registered app or website.
Check the interest rate and name on the official website before paying.
If anyone later asks for OTP or an extra fee, stop — that is a scam.
what_to_do_hi: केवल आधिकारिक रास्ते से निवेश करें: डाकघर, अपनी बैंक शाखा, या कंपनी का पंजीकृत ऐप/वेबसाइट।
भुगतान से पहले आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर ब्याज दर और नाम जाँच लें।
अगर बाद में कोई OTP या अतिरिक्त फ़ीस माँगे, तो रुक जाएँ — वह धोखा है।
